notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard HLAfederation MIM object, HLAunicodeString, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation name. It verifies the created federation name, a non-empty RTI version without constraining its provider-defined format, the standard MIM designator, and the exact time-implementation name supplied at federation creation through ordinary discovery, subscription, request, and reflection; it asserts no provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador MIM federation creation, join, standard MOM handle lookup, subscription, object identity lookup, attribute value request, and resignation/destruction services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks for the standard static federation identity attributes
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::createFederationExecutionWithMIM, RTIambassador::joinFederationExecution, RTIambassador::getObjectClassHandle, RTIambassador::getAttributeHandle, RTIambassador::subscribeObjectClassAttributes, RTIambassador::requestAttributeValueUpdate, FederateAmbassador::discoverObjectInstance, FederateAmbassador::reflectAttributeValues, HLAfederation.HLAfederationName, HLAfederation.HLARTIversion, HLAfederation.HLAMIMdesignator, HLAfederation.HLAtimeImplementationName, HLAunicodeString
